claims.explanation: Epirubicin is a topoisomerase II poison whose activity depends on TOP2A and on proliferative/DNA-damage-response context; selective killing tracks with intact p53-pathway and homologous-recombination/DNA-damage-response proficiency, since TP53-mutant and HR-defective lines are enriched among sensitive lines, while RAS/MAPK-driven and p53-competent lines are relatively protected. The pattern is best explained by loss of p53 (and cooperating DNA-repair defects) removing cell-cycle arrest/senescence and shifting cells toward mitotic catastrophe after topoisomerase II-induced double-strand breaks.

features.basis: TP53 mutation is highly enriched in the most-killed lines (18/20) versus few protected lines, consistent with loss of p53-mediated arrest after topoisomerase II damage
Epirubicin is a topoisomerase II poison; higher TOP2A expression increases drug target and DNA-damage generation
PTEN loss appears in several sensitive lines (FTC133, ZR751, UACC62, HEC265) and impairs DNA-damage-induced arrest/repair
NF1 mutation is enriched among sensitive lines (S117, LOXIMVI, FTC133), possibly via RAS-driven replication stress
PIK3CA mutation appears in multiple sensitive lines (HGC27, MKN1, SNU840), linking PI3K activation to increased replication stress
FBXW7 mutation in sensitive lung/gastric lines may impair degradation of DNA-damage/oncogenic proteins
BRAF-mutant melanoma/colorectal lines are overrepresented among least-affected lines (IGR37, K029AX, SNUC5), suggesting MAPK-driven quiescence/protection
KRAS mutation is enriched in protected lines (KPNSI9S, T3M4, GSU, SNU410, CL11, OV7), possibly reflecting reduced topoisomerase II dependence
EGFR-mutant NSCLC lines appear in both groups but include protected HCC4006, suggesting EGFR-driven survival signaling limits anthracycline killing
CDKN2A loss in protected lines (MHHES1, K029AX, SNU1214) may reflect a distinct proliferation/senescence context
ATM mutation in sensitive SNU685 and protected 786O/SNUC5 is inconsistent, but ATM loss can impair DSB repair after topoisomerase II damage
ARID1A mutation appears in several sensitive lines (LOXIMVI, HEC265) and may impair chromatin-based DNA-damage responses
